channel.title: Midlife Survivors Devlog
channel.description: HR memos from building Midlife Survivors.

item.title: The office got bigger. Somebody lost a binder.
item.description: The art preview grows an atrium, side wings and a records annex with a lost binder. The map fills in as you walk.

item.title: There's a coffee button now. It feels weird.
item.description: Asking for money feels weird, so here is exactly where it goes: more AI time to finish this game. Also, I am looking for people who want to help build it.

item.title: I could beat my own game standing still. So I hired a robot.
item.description: Four minutes in, I could put the controller down. A test bot, a Grok review and a Comfort Zone Tax fixed that.

item.title: The office has seen a few restructurings.
item.description: Accounts Payable gets desks with personality, a jammed printer, and a plant that needs PTO.

item.title: The office has people in it now. And they walk.
item.description: Walking sheets for the 9-to-5er, Soccer Dad, and Grad Student. Four directions, feet that stop when you do.

item.title: I've never made a game. Here's a green dollar sign chasing a square.
item.description: A photographer, Vampire Survivors, and the moment midlife became a bullet hell.
